request.text:
Customer: Hi, I’m Maya Chen. The weekly export stops at 80%.

Agent: I can send a reproduction to our integration vendor. Which account is affected?

Customer: My email is maya.chen@example.com and my account is NW-2048. You can call +1 202 555 0148.

Agent: Thanks. We can reproduce this when the date filter is set to last month. The workaround is to export one week at a time.

types.account_id: A customer account, order, or ticket identifier

notes: Single serial live probe of shipped sample. Additional short Unicode, negative and repeated-mention probes passed; this is not a recall guarantee.
Offsets are Unicode code points. All probabilities are retained; no cutoff hides low-confidence spans.
